name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires reaching the goal after opening the door, but the soft RespondedExistence has_key, at_goal clause does not enforce this. Remove the soft RespondedExistence clause and add a hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) clause to require at_goal after has_key.

texts: get to the goal square if you can
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u2, has_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 6
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 11
(u2, has_key, u1) -> 11
